item.text:
This turn hardened the one finding I have. [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_01-10-40-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md) §3 (F2) is updated with the new evidence.

**F2 (confirmed, executed): admin `snapshot` command rate limit is 1000× looser than configured/documented.**

- `Commands.java:766` — `new RateLimiter(1, rateLimiterInterval, TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS)`; the sibling `RestoreCommand` at `Commands.java:646` uses `TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS` with the *same* value.
- That value is `Integer.parseInt(System.getProperty("zookeeper.admin.rateLimiterIntervalInMS", "300000"))` (line 88), and `zookeeperAdmin.md:2228` says the interval "Defaults to 5 mins". `RateLimiter` converts via `unit.toMillis(...)`, so `snapshot` enforces 300 ms instead of 300 s.
- New corroboration this turn: `TimeUnit.MICROSECONDS` appears exactly once in the entire main source of `zookeeper-server`/`zookeeper-jute`, and there are only two `new RateLimiter(...)` call sites, both fed by the same millisecond-typed value — so this is an isolated unit slip, not a convention.
- Why the suite misses it: the test harness globally sets `zookeeper.admin.rateLimiterIntervalInMS = "0"` (`ZKTestCase.java:102`, `common/ssl/Cert.java:63`), zeroing the interval for both commands; no test in `server/admin/` mentions the rate limiter, the property or HTTP 429; those classes were also never part of the executed sweep.
- Reproduction stays under `work/repro/` (`SnapshotRateLimitCheck.java`, `out.txt`): reflecting the production objects gives `SnapshotCommand intervalInMs = 300` vs `RestoreCommand = 300000`, and a second snapshot request is admitted again after 400 ms. Command and output are in the report.

Status unchanged otherwise: 239 test classes / 1763 tests executed, the consensus/Zab surface reviewed with no deviation found, one non-environmental test failure falsified as a race, and the three environment blockers documented. Remaining leads (report §6): an end-to-end admin check (two rapid `/commands/snapshot` calls returning 200/200 instead of 200/429) with a non-zero interval, the unrunnable `QuorumSSLTest`/Kerberos/hammer classes, the two hostname-blocked FLE election tests, and the leftover 3.9.x fix-checklist items.
